subject: planner: allow cartesian joins in greedy join order algo to explore better join orders (#63309)
summary: Adds sysvar tidb_opt_cartesian_join_order_threshold (default 0) and extends greedy join reordering to optionally consider no-EQ-edge (cartesian) joins for all-inner-join groups using a multiplicative penalty factor; reviewed the planner/sessionctx diff and minimal surrounding code and found no remaining Blocker/High issues in correctness, SQL semantics, or session behavior.
